items.title: Self-evolving Agentic Customer Support System at LinkedIn
items.title_zh: LinkedIn 的自演化智能体客服系统
items.summary: LinkedIn describes a production support system that combines retrieval-augmented generation with evolutionary auto-prompting and a modular evaluation framework, treating prompts, retrieval and evaluation as a closed-loop versioned workflow without retraining foundation models. In a two-week user-randomized A/B test it raised QA self-serve by 9.0 percentage points, cancellation self-serve by 4.8 points and routing accuracy by 30.6 points.

items.title: BDH-CQ: In-Context Learning with Recurrent Latent Reasoning
items.title_zh: BDH-CQ：结合上下文学习与循环潜在推理
items.summary: BDH-CQ combines in-context learning with recurrent latent reasoning, letting inputs presented at inference time continuously update a recurrent memory and solving queries through iterative computation in a high-dimensional latent space without verbalizing intermediate steps. A 150M-parameter configuration reaches 29.5% pass@2 on ARC-AGI-1 at a computed cost of $0.0007 per task, which the authors say sets a new state of the art on the benchmark's cost-accuracy Pareto frontier.

items.title: Cracks in the Foundation: Seemingly Minor Architectural Choices Impact Long Context Extension
items.title_zh: 地基上的裂缝：看似微小的架构选择会影响长上下文扩展
items.summary: The authors show that four minor architectural choices used by at least one of the Olmo, Llama and Qwen dense families compound to hurt long-context extensibility, with three or more combined dropping downstream performance by up to 47% in ways short-context loss does not reveal. After more than 170,000 GPU hours of controlled ablations they release OlmPool, 26 comparable 7B models with checkpoints before and after long-context extension.

items.title: Muse Glimmer: 30B-parameter model optimized for always-on local agent workflows
items.title_zh: Muse Glimmer：面向常驻本地智能体工作流的 30B 参数模型
items.summary: Meta Superintelligence Labs released Muse Glimmer, a 30-billion-parameter open agentic model optimized for always-on local agent workflows on consumer hardware.

items.title: Not a Monolith: Lab-Level Divergence in the Cooperative Equilibria of Chinese Frontier LLM Agents
items.title_zh: 并非铁板一块：中国前沿 LLM 智能体合作均衡中的实验室级差异
items.summary: The study compares four Chinese frontier models — DeepSeek V4 Pro, Qwen3-Max, Kimi K2.5 and GLM-5.1 — in an evolutionary Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma while holding the strategy-to-code converter fixed across labs. It reports that the labs differ significantly in aggressive-equilibrium proportion, from 1% for Qwen3-Max to 9% for DeepSeek V4 Pro, and that within-ecosystem variation exceeds the average gap between the Chinese and Western ecosystems.

items.title: Beyond Decision Boundaries: Relational Geometry Attacks on Contrastive Embedding Manifolds
items.title_zh: 超越决策边界：对比嵌入流形上的关系几何攻击
items.summary: The paper introduces a geometry-aware adversarial attack that corrupts relational structure in contrastive embedding manifolds by pushing positive pairs apart and pulling negative pairs closer, using an offline-trained generator to produce perturbations in a single forward pass. On the Markmatch verification system it reduces accuracy from 95.4% to 38.6% and completely reverses the positive-negative similarity structure.

items.title: Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs
items.title_zh: Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs：为每个智能体提供可写文件系统工作区
items.summary: LayerFS gives each AI agent a complete, writable filesystem workspace layered over shared committed history without copying the base, letting agents work in parallel, commit changes as deduplicated checkpoints, and branch, rewind or merge. It is written in Rust.

items.title: Show HN: Needle2: 14MB agentic LLM for phones, wearables, smart home and robots
items.title_zh: Show HN：Needle2——面向手机、可穿戴设备、智能家居和机器人的 14MB 智能体 LLM
items.summary: Cactus released Needle 2, a 14MB agentic LLM with 45 million parameters at 2-bit compression that runs a full session in 28MB of RAM, decoding at 500 tokens per second on a Raspberry Pi 5 and 300–1,500 tokens per second on VR headsets and sub-$200 phones.

items.title: Humanising LLM Outputs Is Dumb
items.title_zh: 把 LLM 输出“人性化”很愚蠢
items.summary: The blog post examines signals of shifting AI culture on X, GitHub and Hacker News, including agent skills and AGENTS.md instructions that ask models to answer only in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English, and argues that humanising LLM outputs is unwise.
